how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Every successful primary mint produces one $5 commission. A valid referral sends it to the referrer, while a mint without a referral code sends it to a random existing NFT holder; secondary-market sales do not produce commissions.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Every successful primary mint produces one Small Block prize ticket for the current draw. A valid referral sends it to the referrer, while a mint without a referral code sends it to a random existing NFT holder; secondary-market sales do not produce tickets, and more tickets provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through a fair Chainlink VRF draw.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions and prizes are sent automatically to the user's wallet, with prize results and notifications available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.
